title: Seam coverage, overlap, and silhouette quality
plainLanguage: A technically connected arm can still look broken if a gap opens at the shoulder or if the wrong layer shows through.
purpose: Make visual assembly quality a first-class part of compatibility.

rules.statement: Compatibility tests must inspect seam coverage and full silhouette, not only joint coordinates.
Allow intentional artwork overlap around joints so pieces can tuck under hosts.
Do not change the anatomical joint to fix a seam; change artwork overlap, pivot mechanics, layer order, or artwork variant.

implementation.currentSupport: Not yet a Corpus Pane function.
implementation.futureWork: Add seam/silhouette checks to poser compatibility records.
